authors: Efraín Ponce de León González
title: Enfoque de la gestión escolar sobre la inclusión educativa
abstract: The purpose of this documentary research work was to analyze the importance of educational inclusion and the relationship it has with correct school management in obtaining favorable results in the integral development of students. Documentary research methodology was used to search for information. For the synthesis and analysis, conceptual cartography was used with the support of the eight axes. The documentary research made it possible to analyze different documents related to educational inclusion from a school management approach, highlighting as a result the relevance of the concept, its link with social and pedagogical factors, the difference that exists with school integration, in addition to pointing out the importance of school management by organizing administrative, pedagogical and human resources to attend to diversity and reduce exclusion. It was possible to identify the main characteristics of educational inclusion, the contributions it has to society, the cultural context and the importance of pedagogical management practices to address the diversity of students. It is recommended to investigate school management strategies that favor educational inclusion.

title: El liderazgo directivo como herramienta para la gestión escolar en educación primaria
abstract: The purpose of this documentary research article was to investigate the influence that managerial leadership exerts to efficiently carry out the management process in a school institution, as well as determine the most effective type of leadership in said process. In this research, the methodology of conceptual cartography was used, which consists of systematizing, analyzing, constructing, communicating and learning concepts and theories, based on eight axes which are: notion, categorization, characterization, differentiation, division or applications, linkage. , methodology and exemplification. The results achieved were to differentiate the characteristics of each of the leadership styles that a school manager can exercise in his or her workplace; identify which of these leadership styles, with their practice, promoted more effective school management and; determine that the practice of a single leadership style in a primary educational institution is less effective than combining two or more of them. Concluding that directive leadership within the school is identified as the second factor that has the most impact on learning processes; that the director becomes the school leader who professionally assumes the direction of the educational establishment and as such communicates and interacts with others to, mainly, develop institutional management and make decisions and; Since the role played by the director is not an easy task, it is necessary to acquire certain knowledge that allows him to link what he has learned with practice, with the purpose of focusing attention on the needs that arise.

title: Liderazgo educativo, hospitalidad pedagógica y justicia curricular: una revisión crítica de la gestión escolar contemporánea
abstract: El presente artículo estudia los cambios recientes en el liderazgo educativo en Latinoamérica y aporta el concepto de cortisol institucional como categoría heurística clave para analizar el desgaste biopsicosocial en el magisterio, resultado de la tiranía del formato y del exceso administrativo. Compara los modelos gerenciales tradicionales con la ética de la hospitalidad y con los enfoques de justicia curricular. Propone a partir de una revisión crítica de investigaciones publicadas entre 2021 y 2026 en las bases de datos Scopus, SciELO y Redalyc, un marco interpretativo que integra la gestión de la ternura, el principio de mandar obedeciendo y la hospitalidad pedagógica como alternativas para transformar la gestión escolar. Se seleccionaron 52 artículos revisados por pares sobre gobernanza escolar, estrés organizacional y modelos democráticos de dirección. Asimismo, el artículo avanza al sistematizar los tipos de acompañamiento mediador y reflexivo que promueven una ecología de saberes. Se concluye que el enfoque innovador de este estudio radica en proponer la adopción de una gobernanza comunitaria centrada en la alteridad y el cuidado mutuo, lo cual resulta fundamental para reducir el agotamiento laboral docente y promover una educación pública más inclusiva, democrática y pertinente a las realidades locales de la región.

authors: Paola Elizabeth García Molina; Andrés Guillermo Ulloa Mora; Cesar Ricardo Castillo Montufar
title: El Papel del Gestor Educativo en la Capacitación Docente del Bachillerato General Unificado
abstract: El estudio analizó el papel del gestor educativo en la capacitación docente del Bachillerato General Unificado de la Unidad Educativa de las Fuerzas Armadas “Liceo Naval Galápagos”. Se empleó un enfoque mixto, con diseño no experimental, transversal, descriptivo y propositivo. Participaron diez docentes y un gestor educativo. La información se obtuvo mediante encuesta con escala Likert, entrevista semiestructurada y revisión documental. Los resultados de la encuesta, expresados en frecuencias compatibles con el tamaño muestral, mostraron que seis de diez docentes ubicaron la identificación de necesidades formativas en la categoría “A veces”; ocho de diez concentraron la planificación institucional entre “A veces” y “Casi siempre”; y siete de diez percibieron el acompañamiento posterior entre “Nunca” y “Casi nunca”. La entrevista confirmó que las acciones formativas responden principalmente a necesidades inmediatas y que la carga administrativa limita el liderazgo pedagógico. La revisión documental no evidenció matrices sistemáticas de diagnóstico, cronogramas permanentes ni mecanismos formalizados de evaluación del impacto. La triangulación identificó una brecha entre la ejecución de capacitaciones y su transferencia efectiva al aula. Se diseñó un programa institucional basado en diagnóstico, formación contextualizada, acompañamiento y evaluación continua. Se concluye que el fortalecimiento del liderazgo pedagógico del gestor constituye una condición estratégica para convertir la capacitación docente en un proceso pertinente, sostenible y orientado a la mejora de la práctica educativa.

authors: Mireia Tintoré; Joaquín Gairín Sallán; Ilídia Cabral; José Matías Alves; Rosário Serrão Cunha
title: Management model, leadership and autonomy in Portuguese and Spanish public schools: A comparative analysis
abstract: The organisation of K-18 schools and the management function are similar in Portugal and Spain, although, in recent years, Portugal has surpassed Spain’s educational results. Based on the last international reports, this article compares the educational systems of both countries considering some variables related to the management model: (i) the general organisation of education in these stages, (ii) the characteristics of the teaching profession, including the process of recruitment and selection of teachers and principals, and (iii) the level of school autonomy and the type of management and leadership. Findings corroborated the existence of structural proximity in the governance of schools within the framework of a management model that is both centralized and participatory. However, there are differences in the permanency of educational laws, the duration of compulsory education, the grouping of schools, and the requirements to be a teacher. We conclude that the policies undertaken by Portugal to improve education (such as the extension of compulsory schooling, legislative stability, or the rethinking of the internal organization of schools) are succeeding and can serve as an example for Spain. Both countries could help principals become leaders for learning and improve their autonomy to favour changes in education.

authors: Víctor Humberto Loaiza Sánchez; Diego Jasmany Rojas Ortega; Dennis Silvana Mindiolaza Campos; Rosendo Enrique Alvear Renjifo
title: Liderazgo Pedagógico frente a la Crisis Educativa: Adaptarse a tiempos de incertidumbre
abstract: Este artículo analiza el rol del liderazgo pedagógico como una respuesta estratégica frente a las crisis educativas que afectan la estabilidad y el funcionamiento de las instituciones escolares. El objetivo central es examinar cómo los líderes educativos pueden adaptarse a contextos de invulnerabilidad mediante prácticas transformadoras, ética y colaborativas. Partiendo de la pregunta: ¿Cómo puede liderazgo pedagógico sostener procesos educativos significativos en medio de situaciones críticas?, se propone una reflexión orientada a identificar claves de acción en escenarios adversos. La metodología adaptada fue de tipo cualitativo, basada en el análisis documental de fuentes académicas desde el año 2018 y 2025, con un enfoque crítico-interpretativo que permitió vincular teoría y prácticas. Los resultados revelan que un liderazgo efectivo debe ser empático, reflexivo, y capaz de generar procesos colectivos de resiliencia y cambios institucional. En la discusión general, se destaca que el liderazgo distribuido, la atención al bienestar emocional y la adaptación contextual son pilares esenciales para sostener la educación en tiempos complejos. Se concluye que el liderazgo pedagógico debe evolucionar hacia una dimensión más humana, reflexiva y ética, capaz de reinventar la escuela desde sus propios desafíos.

authors: Carolaine Flores Huaman; Edith Sisa Martinez
title: Liderazgo transformacional y desempeño directivo en educación secundaria peruana: revisión sistemática (2020–2025)
abstract: Introduction: Transformational leadership is a relevant construct for understanding processes of institutional improvement and strengthening in education, particularly because of its association with management practices and school leadership performance. Objective: To critically analyze the empirical evidence published between 2020 and 2025 on the relationship between transformational leadership and school leadership performance in secondary schools in Peru. Methodology: A systematic literature review was conducted following the PRISMA 2020 guidelines. Twenty studies retrieved from six academic databases were examined, focusing on empirical research addressing transformational leadership and school leadership performance in Peruvian secondary education institutions. Results: The studies reviewed showed positive associations between transformational leadership and various dimensions of school leadership performance, including instructional leadership, institutional climate, decision-making, and institutional coordination. Correlational designs and convenience-based non-probability sampling predominated. The absence of experimental and quasi-experimental studies limits the establishment of causal relationships between the variables. Conclusions: The available evidence indicates a consistent association between transformational leadership and school leadership performance in Peruvian secondary schools; however, the methodological characteristics of the studies constrain the strength of the inferences that can be drawn. More precise conceptual frameworks and longitudinal, comparative, and intervention-based designs are needed to strengthen the internal and external validity of the evidence in Latin American educational contexts.

title: El liderazgo pedagógico inclusivo y su relación con la equidad educativa
abstract: El liderazgo pedagógico inclusivo es esencial para asegurar una educación equitativa, ya que fomenta entornos de aprendizaje donde todos los estudiantes tienen la misma oportunidad de desarrollarse plenamente. Este tipo de liderazgo requiere la implementación de estrategias flexibles, la formación continua de los docentes y la creación de una cultura escolar que valore la diversidad y la inclusión. Mediante enfoques como el liderazgo transformacional y distribuido, se busca disminuir las brechas de desigualdad y mejorar el rendimiento académico de todos los estudiantes, especialmente aquellos en situaciones de vulnerabilidad. A pesar de los obstáculos, como la resistencia al cambio y la falta de recursos, el liderazgo inclusivo se ha demostrado como una herramienta eficaz para reducir la deserción escolar y fortalecer la integración de los alumnos en el aula. Es vital que las instituciones educativas fortalezcan la capacitación de sus líderes y adopten políticas que promuevan una educación accesible y justa, donde la diversidad se considere una oportunidad para enriquecer el proceso de enseñanza-aprendizaje.

authors: Génesis Tatiana Castro Díaz; Kerlly Marisela Suárez Guerrero; Petra Yolanda Diaz Torres; Guissella Lilibeth Vélez Oviedo
title: El Impacto del Liderazgo Educativo en la Calidad de la Enseñanza en Instituciones Públicas del Ecuador
abstract: El presente artículo de revisión analiza el papel del liderazgo educativo en la mejora de la calidad de la enseñanza en las instituciones públicas del Ecuador. A través de un enfoque cualitativo y una revisión documental sistemática y descriptiva, se examinaron fuentes nacionales e internacionales que abordan diversos modelos de liderazgo: transformacional, instruccional, distribuido, ético y pedagógico. Los resultados evidencian que el liderazgo eficaz influye de manera significativa en el desempeño docente, el compromiso estudiantil, la gestión escolar y el clima institucional. En el contexto ecuatoriano, se identificó una transición hacia estilos de liderazgo más democráticos y participativos, aunque persisten desafíos como la burocracia, la falta de formación especializada y la escasa autonomía en la toma de decisiones. Se destacan prácticas exitosas relacionadas con la motivación del personal, el acompañamiento pedagógico, el uso de datos para la mejora continua y la construcción de una visión compartida. Asimismo, se propone el fortalecimiento del liderazgo a través de programas de formación profesional, estrategias de liderazgo distribuido y redes de colaboración institucional. En conclusión, el liderazgo educativo representa un eje estratégico fundamental para transformar la educación pública ecuatoriana, siempre que se lo implemente de forma contextualizada, ética y sostenible.

authors: Alex Ernesto Vélez García; Jenny Mercedes Vecherel Catagua; Gloria Amparo Briones Mendoza; Carla Viviana Crispin Benalcazar
title: El rol del liderazgo pedagógico y su incidencia en la educación inclusiva
abstract: El liderazgo pedagógico se ha convertido en un componente esencial para el desarrollo de la educación inclusiva, comprendida como aquella que garantiza el acceso, aprendizaje y participación de todos los educandos, sin distinción de origen, capacidades o condiciones. Esta investigación es un estudio de revisión bibliográfica enfocado en el análisis del rol que desempeñan los directivos escolares en la generación de entornos educativos inclusivos. Se examinó trabajos que destacan cómo el liderazgo transformacional, distribuido y ético contribuye a generar culturas escolares enfocada en la equidad, la colaboración y el respeto a la diversidad. Los hallazgos evidencian que los lideres pedagógicos inclusivos fomentan prácticas reflexivas en el personal docente, promoviendo el trabajo en equipo, articulando visiones compartidas y gestionando recursos para atender las necesidades de todo el estudiantado. Además, se identificaron barreras como la falta de formación específica, la resistencia institucional al cambio y la deficiente articulación entre políticas educativas y prácticas escolares. La discusión plantea la urgencia de fortalecer el liderazgo pedagógico desde una perspectiva inclusiva, reconociendo su potencial transformador en los entornos escolares diversos. Se finaliza que el liderazgo pedagógico inclusivo no solo eleva la calidad educativa, sino que también constituye una herramienta clave para lograr sistemas educativos justos, democráticos y sensibles a las diferencias individuales.

title: El liderazgo pedagógico como facilitador del desarrollo profesional docente
abstract: El presente artículo tiene como objetivo analizar el liderazgo pedagógico como un factor clave en la promoción del desarrollo profesional docente, reconociendo su capacidad de influir en la mejora continua de las prácticas educativas. Desde una metodología de enfoque cualitativo y diseño documental, se realizó una revisión sistemática de fuentes académicas, normativas y estudios empíricos publicados entre 2018 y 2025. La problemática central plantea: ¿de qué manera el liderazgo pedagógico puede incidir efectivamente en la formación y el desempeño de los docentes dentro del sistema escolar? A partir del análisis de contenido temático, se identificaron evidencias que demuestran una relación significativa entre el rol de los líderes escolares y el crecimiento profesional del cuerpo docente. La discusión revela que cuando el liderazgo se orienta hacia el acompañamiento pedagógico, el trabajo colaborativo y la construcción de comunidades de aprendizaje, se generan entornos institucionales propicios para la innovación, la reflexión docente y la mejora educativa. No obstante, se advierte la necesidad de fortalecer la formación de los líderes escolares y reducir las barreras estructurales que limitan su impacto. En este marco, el liderazgo pedagógico se consolida como una herramienta estratégica para impulsar transformaciones profundas en la calidad de la educación.

authors: Jimmy Alonso Arrobo Zavala
title: Gestión Educativa e Incidencia Conductual en Educandos con TEA de Bachillerato
abstract: La atención de los incidentes conductuales de estudiantes con Trastorno del Espectro Autista (TEA) en el bachillerato exige que las instituciones educativas dispongan de procesos claros de prevención, intervención y seguimiento. El objetivo del estudio fue analizar la gestión educativa para la atención de incidentes conductuales en estudiantes con TEA del nivel de bachillerato de una unidad educativa particular de la ciudad de Guayaquil. Se desarrolló una investigación cuantitativa, de alcance descriptivo, con diseño no experimental y transversal. Se aplicó una encuesta de diez preguntas, con escala de Likert de tres alternativas, a los 35 docentes de bachillerato de la institución, y los datos se procesaron con estadística descriptiva en el programa JASP. Entre el 71,43% y el 77,14% de los docentes manifestó que no se aplican normas claras, estrategias de manejo conductual positivo ni protocolos definidos, y que no cuenta con formación suficiente, mientras que el 51,43% percibió como insuficiente la coordinación con el Departamento de Consejería Estudiantil y con la familia. Además, el 62,86% señaló que los incidentes son frecuentes y el 80,00% que su intensidad requiere intervención adicional. Se concluye que la gestión educativa necesita fortalecerse mediante formación docente continua, protocolos institucionales y coordinación sistemática. A partir de estos hallazgos se elaboró una propuesta de estrategias de comunicación, pedagógicas y socioemocionales, junto con una ruta de actuación, para orientar la atención inclusiva de los incidentes conductuales.

authors: Juan Ramos Gonzales
title: Competencias digitales y gestión educativa de los docentes en una Institución Educativa Lima, Perú
abstract: En un contexto de transformación digital en la cual nos encontramos y que está produciendo nuevos desafíos en el campo educativo, demanda que los docentes desarrollen y fortalezcan sus competencias digitales que les favorezcan optimizar los procesos pedagógicos y de gestión institucional. Ante este contexto, la presente investigación tuvo como objetivo determinar la relación entre las competencias digitales y la gestión educativa en docentes de una institución educativa pública de Lima – Perú. El estudio se llevó a cabo bajo un enfoque cuantitativo, con diseño no experimental, de corte transversal y de tipo correlacional. La muestra estuvo compuesta por un total de 60 docentes seleccionados mediante un muestreo no probabilístico. Para la recolección de datos se utilizaron dos cuestionarios estructurados de 28 ítems cada uno, que obtuvieron altos niveles de confiabilidad (alpha = 0,966 para competencias digitales y alpha = 0,954 para la gestión educativa). Los resultados evidenciaron una correlación positiva moderada y estadísticamente significativa entre las competencias digitales y la gestión educativa (r=0,481; p=0,001). Además, se encontró una asociación positiva alta entre las competencias digitales y la gestión pedagógica (r=0,759; p=0,001), así también correlaciones positivas y significativas con la gestión administrativa (r=0,314; p=0,015) y la gestión comunitaria (r=0,334; p=0,009). Se concluye que, el fortalecimiento de las competencias digitales de los docentes se asocia significativamente con un desempeño más eficiente de la gestión educativa lo que favorece la transformación de los procesos institucionales.

title: La profesionalización docente: hacia un liderazgo escolar efectivo
abstract: The purpose of this documentary research was to reflect on the importance of teacher professionalization as a means of training and developing the necessary skills to provide an educational service of excellence. This implies that the teacher faces his new role, is trained and updated on different areas of the school context. The methodology used consisted of a documentary analysis, as well as the use of conceptual cartography to guide the work to be carried out. The results obtained allowed us to identify the notion of teacher professionalization as a dynamic process, through which the skills and competencies of teachers are perfected, as well as critical and committed reflection on their educational practice. The following axes could be determined in the methodology of teacher professionalization: diagnosis of the educational needs of students, diagnosis of the training needs of teachers and managers, design of located training paths, training in the subject, design of the educational project, implementation of the educational project, systematization of the experience and certification. It is suggested to develop field studies to validate the proposed methodology with basic education teachers.

title: Estudio de la distribución del liderazgo en los centros escolares a través del análisis de redes sociales. Eficacia docente colectiva y confianza como elementos de análisis de la red social
abstract: Esta investigación analiza la trama de relaciones sociales establecida por el profesorado de centros escolares de educación primaria. Igualmente analiza, como subproductos de dicha trama, la distribución del liderazgo, la ?confianza? como propiedad organizativa y la percepción de los miembros sobre su "eficacia docente colectiva". Para la medición de la "eficacia docente colectiva" y la "confianza" se han validado los instrumentos. En una primera fase cuantitativa se aplicó la metodología de Análisis de Redes Sociales (ARS), así como sendos cuestionarios estandarizados para la recogida de datos sobre los constructos "confianza" y "eficacia docente colectiva". En una segunda fase cualitativa se mantuvieron entrevistas en profundidad con los participantes, para completar y matizar los datos cuantitativos. El Análisis de Redes Sociales nos permite establecer la matriz de relaciones declarada por el profesorado de cada centro en cuatro ámbitos: curricular, gestión, convivencia e innovación. Los datos, sometidos a análisis mediante el programa informático UCINET VI, nos permiten conocer tanto características estructurales de la red (densidad, centralización, o estructura de subgrupos) como de sus miembros (diferentes modalidades de centralidad). Además, el análisis cruzado de estos datos facilita la identificación de los patrones de liderazgo emergentes en la red: "focalizado", "múltiple", "alternativo" o "sin liderazgo". Finalmente se analizaron las relaciones entre los resultados referidos a los tres constructos: liderazgo, confianza y eficacia docente colectiva. El estudio nos ha permitido establecer conclusiones de las que se espera un impacto potencial para la mejora del liderazgo escolar y las relaciones de colaboración entre el profesorado. También nos permite determinar la eficacia de la metodología ARS en el estudio de estos fenómenos.

authors: Yismer Moises Choez Marcillo; Amelia Lorena Quinto Quinto; Betty Verónica Rodríguez Lucas; Diana Mariela Ostaiza Vera
title: El rol del liderazgo pedagógico en la mejora del rendimiento estudiantil
abstract: El presente artículo tiene como objetivo analizar como el liderazgo pedagógico influye en la mejora del rendimiento estudiantil, destacando su impacto tanto en los resultados académicos como en las dimensiones socioemocionales del aprendizaje. La investigación se desarrolló mediante un enfoque cualitativo, sustentado en una revisión sistemática de literatura reciente, que permitió Identificar y sintetizar evidencias teóricas y empíricas sobre las prácticas de liderazgo en contextos escolares. Se partió de la problemática de que, a pesar de la importancia reconocida de liderazgo pedagógico, en muchas instituciones persisten limitaciones como la falta de formación específica de los directivos, la resistencia al cambio docente y condiciones contextuales adversas, lo cual plantea la pregunta ¿Cómo superar estas barreras para lograr un impacto efectivo en el rendimiento del estudiante? La discusión evidencia que un liderazgo pedagógico activo, distribuido e inclusivo, contribuye a la formación del clima escolar, promover la colaboración entre los actores educativos y sostener mejoras duraderas en el aprendizaje. Finalmente, se concluye que potenciar el liderazgo pedagógico requiere no solo de habilidades personales y profesionales de los directivos, sino también de políticas institucionales que respalden su acción y aseguren condiciones adecuadas para su ejercicio.

authors: Irlanda María Rodríguez Navarrete; Elcy Jhanela Roblez Corregidor; María Fernanda Cevallos González; Francis Mercedes Quiñonez Cabeza
title: Liderazgo Pedagógico y la experiencia educativa con estudiantes de discapacidad
abstract: El presente artículo tiene como objetivo analizar cómo el liderazgo pedagógico influye en las experiencias educativas de los estudiantes con discapacidad, identificando prácticas que favorecen su inclusión en el entorno escolar. La investigación adopta un enfoque cualitativo con diseño de estudio de caso, utilizando análisis documental y caracterización temática para comprender las dinámicas escolares desde una perspectiva contextualizada. La problemática central se plantea en torno a la persistencia de barreras físicas, sociales y actitudinales en las instituciones educativas, cuestionando si las decisiones de los líderes pueden transformar las oportunidades de aprendizaje para estos estudiantes. Los resultados sugieren que los líderes con una visión inclusiva son capaces de promover una cultura institucional que valore la diversidad, fomentando la colaboración entre docentes, familias y comunidad, y fortalecer las competencias del personal para atender las necesidades específicas de los estudiantes con discapacidad. La discusión general evidencia que el liderazgo no solo es una función administrativa, sino un motor de cambio que mejora las condiciones educativas y sociales para todos los estudiantes. Se concluye que la formación continua, el compromiso ético y la construcción colectiva son claves para consolidar escuelas más justas y equitativas.

title: Liderazgo directivo en la práctica docente de las escuelas secundarias
abstract: The purpose of this documentary research was to reflect on the importance of directive leadership in teaching practice. This implies that the principal analyzes and reflects on the role he or she plays in the secondary school based on the leadership style he or she exercises, the skills and characteristics that every school leader must possess. The methodology used for this research was through a documentary analysis and implementing the search for information in various indexed journals, all of this through the execution of conceptual mapping to guide the work to be carried out. The results allowed us to identify the type of managerial leadership that is required to seek an education of excellence in educational establishments. The conclusion reflected the importance of managerial leadership in teaching practice today, therefore it is suggested that more studies of this nature be carried out to provide managers with the necessary knowledge to enhance their role and exercise it with professionalism.

title: Liderazgo directivo ante los retos que implica la Nueva Escuela Mexicana
abstract: The purpose of this documentary research was to reflect on managerial leadership in the face of the challenges involved in the New Mexican School. Although when we mention managerial leadership we are referring to the ability of a person to direct and motivate his or her group to achieve the objectives and vision that the school has, today we also know that it becomes an an even more complex task due to the times we are facing. There are challenges due to ignorance or partial knowledge of the new 2023 curriculum and resistance to change by most teachers at different levels of Basic Education, since the New Mexican School includes new work methodologies and an adaptation to the new printed materials (textbooks), a topic of great controversy among parents. The methodology used consisted of a documentary analysis, as well as the use of conceptual cartography to guide the work to be carried out. The results obtained allowed us to identify the notion of directive leadership and how it is linked to educational quality, placing emphasis on the current educational model.

authors: Leydi Patricia Contreras Fernández; Paula Esthefany León Velásquez; Ronald Reinaldo Coello Márquez; Maria Elena Lozano Vera
title: El liderazgo pedagógico y su influencia en el proceso enseñanza-aprendizaje en estudiantes
abstract: La presente revisión bibliográfica analiza el impacto del liderazgo pedagógico en el proceso enseñanza-aprendizaje de estudiantes en todos los niveles educativos del Ecuador, desde un enfoque cuantitativo y centrado en estudios realizados entre 2015 y 2025. La evidencia indica que un liderazgo pedagógico efectivo, ejercido tanto por directivos como por docentes, incide positivamente en la motivación del profesorado, el clima institucional, la inclusión educativa y, en menor medida, en el rendimiento académico. Se destacan estilos como el liderazgo transformacional y distribuido, que favorecen ambientes colaborativos e innovadores. A pesar de que muchos estudios son de tipo correlacional, los resultados muestran una tendencia consistente que respalda la necesidad de fortalecer la formación en liderazgo pedagógico como estrategia para mejorar la calidad educativa en el país. Se concluye que el liderazgo centrado en la enseñanza es un catalizador clave para el éxito académico y el desarrollo integral del estudiantado.

title: The opinion of school managers about learning analytics in school management
abstract: Bu araştırmanın amacı öğrenme analitiğinin okul yönetiminde kullanımına ilişkin okul yöneticilerin görüşlerinin belirlenmesidir. Temel amacı gerçekleştirmek için öğrenme analitiğinin okul yönetiminde kullanımının, okul hafızasının oluşturulması, geleceğe ilişkin eylem planlarının yapılması, destek ihtiyacı bulunan öğrencilerin belirlenmesi ve öğrenme analitiğinin okul yönetiminde kullanılmasının yararlarına ilişkin cinsiyet, yaş ve kıdem değişkenlerine göre değişimine yönelik çalışmalar hakkında okul yöneticilerin görüşleri tespit edilmeye çalışılmıştır. Öğrenme analitiğinin okul yönetiminde kullanımına ilişkin okul yöneticilerin görüşlerinin belirlenmesini amaçlayan bu araştırma, geçmişte ya da halen var olan bir durumu var olduğu şekliyle betimlemeye çalıştığı için tarama modeli temel alınarak desenlenmiştir. Araştırmada farklı araştırma yaklaşımları bir arada kullanılmıştır. Araştırmanın ilk aşamasında Edirne Merkez İlçe ve İlçelerinde görev yapmakta olan 6’sı kadın, 7’si erkek olmak üzere 13 yönetici dâhil edilmiş ve görüşleri alınmıştır. Araştırmada öğrenme analitiğinin okul yönetiminde kullanımına ilişkin okul yöneticilerin görüşlerinin belirlenmesi amacıyla eğitim programı ve eğitim süreci yönetimi, öğretmenlerin desteklenmesi ve geliştirilmesi ile düzenli öğretme öğrenme çevresi temalarına göre çalışma yürütülmüştür. Bu temalar doğrultusunda okul yöneticilerinin öğrenme analitiği çerçevesinde öğretim liderliği rollerinin bilincinde oldukları, okul- öğretmen- veli- öğrenci etkileşimini en iyi şekilde yürüttükleri, başarıyı teşvik edici planlamalar yaptıkları, öğretmenlerin mesleki yönlendirmede teşvik edici çalışmalar gerçekleştirdikleri, okulla ilgili geleceğe yönelik doğru kararlar almak amacıyla sayısal verilerin kayıt altına alınmasının önemini kavradıkları sonuçlarına ulaşılmıştır. Araştırmanın ikinci aşamasında verilerin toplanması için araştırmacı tarafından geliştirilen anket formu kullanılmıştır. Çalışma grubu Edirne İli ve ilçelerinde bulunan okul yöneticilerinden oluşmaktadır. Çalışmaya 2020-2021 Eğitim ve Öğretim yılında Edirne merkez ve ilçelerde MEB’e bağlı okullarda görev yapan Edirne ili ve ilçelerinde bulunan 118 okulun yöneticisi dahil edilmiş ve görüşleri alınmıştır. Anket aracılığıyla elde edilen verileri yedi farklı okul türü ve yüz on sekiz okul yöneticisi ile gerçekleştirilen görüşmelerden elde edilmiştir. Araştırmanın nicel verilerin analizinde genel durumu görmek için frekans ve yüzde dağılım incelenmiştir. Nicel verilerin araştırmada ele alınan değişkenler ile ilişkisinin anlamlı bir şekilde dağılım gösterip göstermediğini belirlemek için ki-kare analizi yapılmıştır. Araştırmada öğrenme analitiğinin okul yönetiminde kullanımına ilişkin okul yöneticilerin görüşlerinin belirlenmesi amacıyla yöneltilen sorulardan öğrenme analitiği sayesinde öğrencilerin elektronik ortamda değerlendirilip, derse olan katılım düzeyleri ve ilgisinin ölçülebileceği, öğretim sürecinde karşılaşılacak aksaklıklar noktasında uyarı görevi üstlenebileceği, ileriye dönük öğretimsel planlamalar yapılabileceği, ders tasarımı, iyileştirme ve yayınlama süreci için girdi elde edilebileceği, öğrenme ortamlarının bireyselleştirilmesinin sağlanabileceği, öğrenme süreçlerinin değerlendirilmesinde öğrenciye görev ve sorumluluk verilebileceği sonuçlarına ulaşılmıştır.

authors: Sana Ghosia; Rashid Mahmood Arain; Muhammad Hashim
title: Exploring the Role of School Management in Supporting Extracurricular Activities and Academic Success in South Punjab
abstract: Education in South Punjab faces persistent challenges, including resource limitations, rote-based learning, and insufficient emphasis on holistic student development. Extracurricular activities (ECAs) are recognised as key contributors to academic success, social skills, and personal growth, but their effectiveness depends heavily on the support of school management. This study investigated the role of school management in promoting ECAs and examined their relationship with students’ academic performance in government high schools of District Muzaffargarh. The population of the study included 150,568 students, 45,122 teachers, and 8,083 administrators across government high schools in District Muzaffargarh. Using a stratified random sampling technique, a sample of 384 respondents was selected, comprising 254 students, 80 teachers, and 50 administrators. Data were collected through structured questionnaires on a 5-point Likert scale and analysed quantitatively. Findings revealed that stakeholders largely perceived school management as supportive of extracurricular activities. Results also showed a positive relationship between student participation in ECAs and academic performance, with some gender-based differences noted among administrators and students. The study concludes that school management plays a vital role in integrating ECAs into school culture, which in turn strengthens academic outcomes and overall development. It recommends policy initiatives to institutionalise ECAs, ensure gender-inclusive participation, and conduct regular program evaluations for sustained impact.

authors: Bruna Brandalise; Ceres Midding; Sandra Mara Zago Dallo
title: ASSESSMENT OF LEARNING FOR STUDENTS WITH DISABILITIES: THE ROLE OF SCHOOL MANAGEMENT IN BUILDING INCLUSIVE ASSESSMENT PRACTICES
abstract: Inclusive education has brought about important changes in how schools understand the teaching and learning of students with disabilities. In this context, assessment needs to move beyond a perspective based solely on grades and results, and begin to consider the journey, possibilities, and needs of each student. This article aims to analyze the role of school management in building inclusive assessment practices for students with disabilities. This is a bibliographic research, with a qualitative and descriptive approach, carried out through the analysis of academic publications produced between 2020 and 2026 on learning assessment, inclusive education, Specialized Educational Services, and school management. The discussion showed that inclusive assessment depends on the use of different strategies and instruments, capable of allowing students to demonstrate their knowledge in diverse ways. It was also possible to perceive that school management plays an important role in this process, especially in promoting continuing education, collective planning, dialogue between teachers and professionals in Specialized Educational Services, and closer ties with families. It is concluded that the construction of inclusive assessment practices is not the exclusive responsibility of the teacher, but involves the entire school organization. In this sense, management can contribute to creating a culture in which assessment is used as a tool for monitoring and promoting learning, respecting the particularities of each student.

title: The Introduction of New Public Management into School Leadership in Japan
abstract: This chapter explores the dissemination and implications of new public management (NPM) as it bears on school leadership in Japan. Following a brief review of the introduction of NPM into school leadership and management, it examines senior high school headteachers&s; use and evaluation of various management tools that originated in the private sector, such as promotion, strength, weakness, opportunity, and threat analysis, differentiation strategies, and market research. The discussion raises a question: why do the headteachers give high evaluations for private-sector management despite their relatively low evaluations of specific management tools? This question is addressed through a Bourdieusian theoretical lens of “misrecognition,” and the implications of NPM for school leadership are discussed, including its possible replacement of Japan&s;s paternalistic culture or “ tate shakai [vertical society].”

title: School Leadership Competencies As A Foundation for Effective Team Management
abstract: School leadership plays a pivotal role in shaping team dynamics and instructional quality within educational institutions. As the educational landscape increasingly embraces collaborative and distributed leadership models, the competencies of school leaders such as emotional intelligence, strategic vision, and instructional support are becoming central to effective team management. Despite acknowledgment of leadership's importance, many systems lack coherent frameworks to identify and cultivate the competencies critical for team cohesion and school development. This study aims to analyze key leadership competencies that underpin effective team management in schools and explore their influence on collaboration, communication, and trust among educators. Through a qualitative multiple case study of ten secondary schools, the findings highlight six core competencies emotional intelligence, strategic vision, communication, instructional leadership, decision-making, and conflict resolution as essential to team cohesion. Communication and trust emerged as central enablers of collaboration, while professional development was found to reinforce leadership impact. The research introduces a Leadership Impact Index (LII), a practical tool for quantifying leadership effectiveness in fostering collaboration, thus offering an innovative bridge between qualitative insights and measurable outcomes. The study underscores the need for competency-based leadership training, the institutionalization of professional development, and the implementation of diagnostic tools to support leadership evaluation. These findings inform both policy and practice, reinforcing leadership development as a strategic imperative for school improvement.

authors: Laura Schlottman
title: The Compliance Trap and Relational Anchors in Structured Instructional Leadership
abstract: Instructional leadership is often displaced by compliance requirements, operational demands, and formal evaluation. This qualitative secondary analysis examined how teachers and principals described organizational pressures and relational practices during a 14-day Build Rapport, Inspire Feedback, Celebrate Success, and Exceed Results (BICE) leadership cycle across five Southern California public charter schools. Data included open-ended survey responses from 33 experienced teachers, interviews with nine teachers, and interviews with six principals. A role-by-source matrix and constant comparison were used to examine demands that displaced developmental work, valued leadership practices, and convergence or tension across participant groups. Two cross-cutting themes emerged. The compliance trap described how urgent operational and accountability demands displaced coaching, recognition, and relationship-building. Relational anchors—approachability, trust, feedback, recognition, collaboration, and human connection—helped preserve developmental relationships within these pressures. Structured, non-evaluative leadership routines may help translate relational commitments into dependable practice by protecting time for connection, observation, recognition, and collective next steps. The findings do not establish that BICE caused teacher retention; rather, they identify practical organizational conditions that may support professional connection and continued development across career stages.

The study results established that instructional leadership styles positively affect students' academic achievement. The study has contributed to identifying a key area in secondary education, namely instructional leadership, which seems to enhance students' educational outcomes. For effective instructional leadership, since it can develop a context that facilitates improvements in academic performance of students, effective school leadership is needed by policymakers and educators. The study suggests that principals who would like to be effective in with tradition notions of instructional leadership may improve the process of improving students' academic performance by creating a supportive learning environment, engaging teachers in developing professional learning community, and improving students' academic performance. The contribution of the study is relevant to the advancement of educational policy and practice. This research establishes that principals in their role for school improvement to focus on developing their instructional leadership practices and students' academic performance provide the basis for any new policy direction. In addition, the results also highlight the importance of principals engaged in leadership development programs and other initiatives that provide support for instructional leadership at secondary level.

authors: Farida Farida; Fatimah Azzahra Ramadani Fazri; Asep Suryana
title: Principals' Instructional Leadership in Implementing Deep Learning in Senior High Schools
abstract: However, even now, learning in public senior high schools is still facing various obstacles such as the domination of memorization teaching strategy, low level of students' involvement in learning, and inadequate development of higher order thinking skills. Thus, the significance of instructional leadership by school principals in transforming learning through deep learning paradigm becomes very apparent. At present, despite growing interest of many countries around the globe toward deep learning as a pedagogic framework, the role of instructional leadership in its implementation process at the secondary education level still remains largely unexplored especially in Indonesia. The current study aimed to investigate the implementation of instructional leadership in deep learning implementation, the strategies used by school principals, and the factors affecting its success or failure. This study used a literature review. Information for analysis was gathered from both national and international peer reviewed journals, books, and scientific publications in Google Scholar, Scopus, and ERIC databases. Content analysis of the collected data has been performed based on Miles et al. (2014) framework. The results of analysis demonstrate that instructional leadership of school principals is an important factor in supporting deep learning through the following aspects: (1) establishing vision of learning; (2) conducting efficient instructional leadership strategies like professional learning community and clinical supervision; (3) incorporating digital technology into the learning process appropriately; (4) developing continuous professional development of teachers; (5) management of supporting and inhibiting factors. Deep learning implementation thus depends largely on the ability of principals to create new quality oriented learning environment. The research will contribute to improvement of educational leadership practice aimed at achievement of Sustainable Development Goal (SDG) 4 regarding provision of quality education for all.

title: Madrasah Head's Instructional Leadership Approach to the Development of New Teachers' Professionalism
abstract: This research aims to explore the instructional leadership of madrasah principals in guiding young teachers at SMA Al-Muhafidzoh Blitar, with a focus on leadership roles and strategies, experiences and perceptions of young teachers, as well as the impact of leadership on student learning outcomes. Qualitative research methods are used with data collection techniques through in-depth interviews, observation and document analysis. The research results show that madrasa heads play a key role in establishing a clear educational vision and implementing strategies such as mentorship programs, regular training, and constructive feedback that are effective in improving young teachers' pedagogical and classroom management skills. Young teachers' experiences and perceptions of the guidance they receive are generally positive, with many stating that the support of madrasah principals is very helpful in increasing their self-confidence and competence, despite several challenges such as time constraints. The impact of instructional leadership on student learning outcomes is clearly visible by increasing academic performance and student engagement in the learning process. This research confirms the importance of effective instructional leadership in creating an educational environment that is conducive to the professional development of young teachers and improving the quality of student learning outcomes at SMA Al-Muhafidzoh Blitar. These findings can be a reference for developing leadership strategies in similar educational institutions

title: TACIT KNOWLEDGE IN INSTRUCTIONAL LEADERSHIP: EVIDENCE FROM MALAYSIAN SECONDARY PRINCIPALS
abstract: Although there is a plethora of studies related to principals’ instructional leadership practice, little attempt has been made to understand their tacit knowledge in this area. Thus, the key purpose of this study is to understand whether Malaysian principals have in-depth knowledge on instructional leadership practice as it is highly emphasised in the Malaysia’s Education Blueprint policy. A total of 202 secondary principals have provided their feedback on their tacit knowledge related to instructional leadership practice. Later, their answers were compared with suggestions from instructional leadership models to see if they coincided. In measuring secondary principals’ tacit knowledge, results indicated that secondary principals have in-depth knowledge on instructional leadership as they achieved a score of over 80 per cent correct answers for 13 out of 15 items to which they were asked to respond. In terms of significant differences, the non-parametric results indicated that there are differences in terms of their experiences in practising instructional leadership. The significant differences were indicated between senior with novice principals with a non-significant difference from principals’ gender and age. Finally, this indicates that principals’ tacit knowledge on instructional leadership was influenced by their leadership experience and age. There are suggestions and recommendations concerning the practical implications of principals’ benefitting from practising instructional leadership.

authors: Deni Deni Samsudin Permana; Gun Gun Gumilar
title: Epistemic Vacancy at the Apex of School Leadership: Repositioning the Principal as Cognitive Supervisor Through a Falsifiable 90-Day Theoretical Synthesis
abstract: Abstract Despite decades of research on school leadership and instructional supervision, to the best of the authors' knowledge no study in the global literature has explicitly argued that the principal's core function—analogous to the teacher's core function of teaching—is to serve as the cognitive quality controller of classroom learning and assessment. This theoretical synthesis paper identifies and diagnoses a foundational conceptual gap at the intersection of three established but disconnected research streams: instructional leadership theory, Bloom's Revised Taxonomy and HOTS research, and assessment quality research. Drawing on a narrative mapping of these streams, we argue that school systems worldwide have defined the principal's role through administrative and managerial competencies (EMASLIM framework; Permendiknas No. 13/2007), while supervision of instructional cognitive quality is treated as one of many coequal functions rather than the primary one. Consequently, the primary theoretical contribution of this paper is fundamentally diagnostic-forensic, aiming to expose this structural blind spot (epistemic vacancy) as the definitive root cause. We propose that this misalignment is a significant contributing factor to persistently low higher- order thinking skills (HOTS), literacy, and critical thinking outcomes particularly in Indonesia and Southeast Asia, where recent studies confirm that 81-98% of classroom assessments operate at the lowest cognitive levels (Sirri et al., 2025; Setyorini, 2025; Fakhrillah & Suharyadi, 2025). We further propose that effective supervision is impossible without the supervisor's mastery of cognitive leveling: the ability to read, classify, and provide developmental feedback on the cognitive demand of teachers' questions, tasks, and assessments across all subject disciplines. The paper also provides explicit theoretical justification for the primacy of the cognitive domain as the strategic supervisory entry point — including its foundational relationship to affective and psychomotor development in vocational contexts. Finally, we introduce the 90-Day Cognitive Supervision Model—a falsifiable design framework proposed for future empirical validation—serving strictly as a structured testbed for this theoretical diagnosis, in which a cognitively competent principal conducting weekly clinical supervision cycles is hypothesized to produce measurable gains in classroom cognitive depth within 90 days. This paper introduces cognitive depth as a measurable outcome that effective instructional supervision must pursue and protect. title: A qualitative inquiry into women principals’ leadership in Malaysia
abstract: The study explores the issue of women principals’ leadership in secondary schools in Malaysia. From 2005-2013, the statistics provided by the Educational Planning and Research Division (EPRD), Ministry of Education (MoE), Malaysia, show that the number of women teachers in Malaysia is more than men. However, when it comes to the principalship of schools, the number of women principals is less as compared to that of men. To understand the way women principals enact leadership in the secondary schools in Malaysia, an interpretivist qualitative research approach was employed in this study. The study examined key priorities that determine the leadership of women principals, the interaction of women principals with the stakeholders, and what values they uphold in practising leadership. It further examined the challenges that women principals face when practising leadership, how they deal with the challenges, as well as the supports that exist for women principals’ success and attainment of their priorities. The study attempts to understand these issues from women principals’ own experiences and perspectives, as well as from the experiences, perceptions and attitudes of those they work with inside and outside the schools. A multiple case study research was designed to understand how four women principals practise leadership in the secondary schools in Malaysia. The inquiry was accomplished through semi structured interviews with women principals and the stakeholders both inside and outside the schools, as well as the observations of the meetings and other schools’ events that involved the participation of the women principals. In addition, the inquiry was also carried out through the analysis of key documents such as minutes of meetings, school progress planner, school magazines, and planning for management and educational administration books. The findings of this study show that there are three main factors that shape and influence the leadership of women principals in secondary schools in Malaysia. These are; excellence (academic and non-academic), spirituality, and togetherness/kebersamaan. Excellent performance of students is a key priority for the leadership of these women principals. To attain and maintain this excellence, women principals are driven by their spiritual nature and culture that involve values of caring and sharing to lead in ways that are collective, reciprocal, and inclusive. The function of togetherness/kebersamaan symbolizes the commitment to achieving success/excellence as a collective rather than as individuals. The study concludes by highlighting context and culture as key factors shaping and influencing women principals’ leadership practice

title: School Heads’ leadership style and performance of the teachers in Congressional District, Division of Quezon City: Basis for proposed development plan
abstract: This study examined the influence of school heads’ leadership styles on teachers’ performance in the Congressional District, Division of Quezon City, during the school year 2021–2022, as the basis for a proposed development plan. Employing a descriptive survey design, the research involved 95 school heads and their corresponding teachers, using purposive sampling to capture perspectives on instructional leadership, learning environment, parental involvement and community partnership, human resource management, and school management operations. Findings revealed that most school heads and teachers were in their prime working years, predominantly female, and possessed graduate-level qualifications. The leadership styles of school heads were generally rated as moderately observed across domains. Correlation analysis indicated significant relationships between leadership styles and demographic variables such as age, gender, educational attainment, and length of service, while position showed no significant correlation. Moreover, a significant relationship was found between leadership styles and teacher performance, as measured by the Individual Performance Commitment and Review Form (IPCRF), where most teachers achieved a “Very Satisfactory” rating. Challenges encountered by school heads included student discipline issues, sustaining stakeholder support, and managing enrollment and retention concerns. Based on these findings, a development plan emphasizing leadership enhancement, professional development, stakeholder collaboration, and instructional improvement was proposed to strengthen leadership effectiveness and teacher performance.

title: Gestão escolar e a democratização do ensino: Uma revisão de literatura
abstract: Ao refletir sobre o tema, observa-se que as diferentes abordagens de gestão são frutos das pessoas que as implementam, sendo que os resultados dessas práticas dependem profundamente da compreensão que cada indivíduo possui sobre o mundo e as realidades do outro. title: PRÁTICAS PEDAGÓGICAS E GESTÃO ESCOLAR DEMOCRÁTICA NO CONTEXTO DA EDUCAÇÃO 4.0
abstract: Nas sociedades humanas, a invenção das tecnologias vem servindo como uma forma de trazer maior praticidade e bem-estar ao homem, adaptando o ambiente às suas necessidades. Com isso, podemos compreender que o uso das tecnologias tem transformado as formas de viver, de compartilhar o conhecimento e de interagir socialmente, fato que repercutiu em mudanças no processo educativo. Sob esse aspecto, surge a percepção que alia às tecnologias digitais à concepção de educação de qualidade e consequentemente, as necessidades educativas atuais. Aliado a isso, surge a concepção de gestão escolar democrática e participativa, à qual todos os membros da comunidade escolar estão aptos a participar da tomada de decisões em prol do interesse educacional coletivo. Nessa perspectiva, o presente artigo busca investigar vantagens e desafios da inserção das tecnologias no âmbito educacional e de que forma a gestão escolar democrática coopera com um ensino fundamentado na educação 4.0.

title: GESTÃO ESCOLAR ESTRATÉGICA: CONEXÃO ENTRE PLANEJAMENTO, LIDERANÇA E RESULTADOS EDUCACIONAIS
abstract: A gestão escolar estratégica surge como um instrumento essencial para o fortalecimento das instituições educacionais, possibilitando a articulação entre planejamento, liderança e execução de ações voltadas à melhoria do processo pedagógico e administrativo. Este estudo discute a importância do planejamento estratégico no contexto escolar, destacando seu papel na definição de objetivos, metas e ações institucionais. Ressalta-se, ainda, a função da liderança educacional na condução e orientação da equipe, a necessidade de tomadas de decisão baseadas em dados e o impacto positivo da gestão estratégica na organização e nos resultados da escola. Diversos estudos demonstram que a gestão escolar eficaz não se limita a tarefas administrativas, mas envolve a integração entre planejamento pedagógico, gestão de pessoas, recursos e processos institucionais. Para tanto, o presente trabalho utiliza revisão bibliográfica crítica e análise conceitual para evidenciar como práticas estratégicas podem transformar a realidade escolar, fortalecendo a aprendizagem e o desenvolvimento integral dos estudantes.
